<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1862569_cmdb_a_0.CMDBCleanupUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CMDBCleanupUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CMDBCleanupUtils = Class.create();
CMDBCleanupUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },

    findDuplicateSerialNumbers: function() {
        var duplicateGroups = 0;
        
        // 1. Using GlideAggregate for performance
        var ga = new GlideAggregate('cmdb_ci_computer');
        ga.addNotNullQuery('serial_number'); // Ignore empty serials
        ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
        ga.groupBy('serial_number');
        ga.query();

        // 2. Evaluating the count
        while (ga.next()) {
            var count = ga.getAggregate('COUNT');
            
            if (count > 1) {
                var serial = ga.getValue('serial_number');
                this._logIncident(serial, count);
                duplicateGroups++;
            }
        }
        
        return "Audit complete. Created incidents for " + duplicateGroups + " duplicate groups.";
    },

    _logIncident: function(serialNumber, count) {
		
        // 3. Auto-generate the Incident
        var inc = new GlideRecord('incident');
        inc.initialize();
        inc.short_description = "CMDB Governance Alert: " + count + " duplicates found for Serial Number " + serialNumber;
        inc.description = "Automated CMDB Audit detected multiple Computer CIs sharing the exact same serial number. Please investigate and merge/retire the duplicates.";
        inc.category = "hardware";
        inc.impact = 2;
        inc.urgency = 2;
        inc.insert();
    },

    type: 'CMDBCleanupUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-20 16:40:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>c243744083af03103740a3d0deaad330</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CMDBCleanupUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CMDB Audit Engine" source="x_1862569_cmdb_a_0">dcb1b84c836f03103740a3d0deaad3fe</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CMDB Audit Engine">dcb1b84c836f03103740a3d0deaad3fe</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_c243744083af03103740a3d0deaad330</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-20 16:40:13</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
